skill.name: lead-magnets
skill.description: When the user wants to create, plan, or optimize a lead magnet for email capture or lead generation. Also use when the user mentions "lead magnet," "gated content," "content upgrade," "downloadable," "ebook," "cheat sheet," "checklist," "template download," "opt-in," "freebie," "PDF download," "resource library," "content offer," "email capture content," "Notion template," "spreadsheet template," or "what should I give away for emails." Use this for planning what to create and how to distribute it. For interactive tools as lead magnets, see free-tools. For writing the actual content, see copywriting. For the email sequence after capture, see emails.
skill.summary: Plans focused lead magnets, capture flows, distribution, and measurement for qualified lead generation.
skill.author: coreyhaines31

security_audit.summary: All five static findings are false positives caused by Markdown filenames or ordinary paid-promotion language. No command execution, system reconnaissance, prompt injection, or other malicious intent was found.

static_findings.snippet: | First leads | Immediately with existing traffic or paid |
- **ads**: For paid promotion of lead magnets

finding_verdicts.reason: The line describes when lead-generation results may begin. It does not request system information or perform reconnaissance.
The backticks are Markdown formatting around context filenames. The instruction checks and reads a local document without executing a shell command.
The line is a section heading for paid marketing channels. It contains no instruction to inspect a device, network, account, or environment.
The phrase requests optional paid amplification in a marketing distribution plan. It does not collect system details or invoke reconnaissance tooling.
The line references a related advertising strategy skill. It does not inspect systems, run commands, or direct unauthorized activity.

content.value_statement: Generic content offers attract weak leads and waste promotion budget. This skill plans focused lead magnets that align buyer intent, capture strategy, distribution, and measurement.
actual_capabilities: Recommends lead magnet formats based on audience, buyer stage, goals, existing assets, timeline, and resources.
Creates content outlines with scope, key sections, estimated effort, and a clear connection to the product.
Designs gating and capture plans covering access model, form fields, landing page structure, and delivery method.
Plans organic, social, partner, popup, content upgrade, and paid distribution channels.
Defines KPIs, benchmark ranges, lead quality signals, and initial A/B testing priorities.
Diagnoses low conversion or poor lead quality using offer, traffic, form, and buyer-stage factors.
limitations: Does not create finished copy, visual designs, downloadable files, landing pages, forms, advertisements, or email sequences.
Benchmark ranges are general guidance and require validation against your traffic source, market, and historical data.
Recommendations depend on accurate business, audience, product, asset, and resource context.
Interactive calculators, graders, and quizzes require a separate free-tool implementation workflow.

use_cases.title: Plan a SaaS Acquisition Offer
use_cases.description: Select a decision-stage template that demonstrates product value, then define capture fields, distribution channels, and lead-to-trial metrics.

use_cases.title: Package Consulting Expertise
use_cases.description: Turn a repeatable client process into a practical checklist or guide with a focused landing page and delivery plan.

use_cases.title: Improve a Content Upgrade
use_cases.description: Diagnose a weak blog offer, reduce consumption effort, align it with reader intent, and prioritize conversion tests.

prompt_templates.title: Recommend One Lead Magnet
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend one lead magnet for [business] serving [audience]. Our main goal is [goal]. Ask only for context needed before presenting your recommendation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Choose a focused starting point with limited context.

prompt_templates.title: Repurpose an Existing Asset
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn our existing [content asset] into a focused lead magnet for [buyer stage]. Provide the format, content outline, gating plan, and estimated creation effort.
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert proven content into a practical acquisition offer.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Conversion Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose why our [lead magnet] converts at [rate] from [traffic source]. Evaluate the offer, format, landing page, form, delivery, and buyer-stage fit. Prioritize three tests.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve an existing offer using observed performance.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full-Funnel Portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a lead magnet strategy for [product] across awareness, consideration, and decision stages. Map each offer to distribution, capture fields, nurture path, KPIs, benchmarks, and tests. Account for [constraints].
prompt_templates.scenario: Coordinate multiple offers across the customer journey.

output_examples.input: We sell project management software to marketing agencies and need a decision-stage lead magnet.
output: Recommendation: Agency Capacity Planning Template for marketing agency operations leaders.
Buyer stage: Decision. The template helps prospects plan workload while exposing coordination gaps the product solves.
Capture plan: Request email and role, show a spreadsheet preview, and deliver access immediately and by email.
Measurement: Track landing page conversion, lead-to-trial rate, and trial starts by source.

output_examples.input: Our 50-page ebook converts at four percent from warm blog traffic.
output: Diagnosis: The offer requires too much reading for visitors seeking a quick result.
First test: Compare the ebook against a short checklist with the full guide offered as an optional resource.
Second test: Preview the first section before requesting an email.
Third test: Reduce form fields and strengthen the headline around one specific outcome.

output_examples.input: Turn our popular email subject line article into a lead magnet.
output: Offer: A one-page subject line cheat sheet plus 25 annotated examples.
Placement: Keep the article ungated and add relevant inline and end-of-article calls to action.
Delivery: Provide instant access on the thank-you page and send a backup email.
KPIs: Measure visitor-to-lead conversion, email engagement, and product-page visits from captured leads.

best_practices: Define one audience, one painful problem, and one desired outcome before choosing a format.
Request only the contact information needed for delivery, segmentation, or immediate follow-up.
Measure conversion and downstream lead quality by source, then test one major variable at a time.
anti_patterns: Do not create a broad ebook when a short checklist or template can deliver the outcome faster.
Do not collect many form fields unless the offer value and qualification need justify the added friction.
Do not judge success by download volume without tracking audience fit, engagement, and progress toward purchase.

faq.question: What lead magnet formats can this skill plan?
faq.answer: It covers checklists, cheat sheets, templates, swipe files, guides, mini-courses, assessments, webinars, resource libraries, trials, and related static offers.

faq.question: Does this skill create the finished lead magnet?
faq.answer: No. It creates the strategy, outline, capture plan, distribution plan, and measurement framework for a separate production workflow.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide your product, ideal customer, buyer stage, acquisition goal, existing assets, current performance, timeline, budget, and available production resources.

faq.question: Can it improve an existing lead magnet?
faq.answer: Yes. It can assess format, scope, offer relevance, gating, form friction, delivery, distribution, conversion rate, and downstream lead quality.

faq.question: Are the included benchmarks guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. They are planning ranges. Validate them against your industry, traffic source, audience intent, offer quality, and historical performance.

faq.question: When should I build a free tool instead?
faq.answer: Choose a free tool when user inputs can produce a valuable personalized result and you can support technical development and maintenance.
